title: 第1813章 道尊九境巅峰第1812章 道祖九境巅峰
slug: 穿书女频大婚当日被女主杀死
content_zh:
俄顷。
宇宙规则涌动，玄妙的力量覆盖长生印，长生印发出一道生死曦光。
这缕曦光透过无尽星空，照射在始界的祭坛之上，叶凌天和澹台凰顿时被曦光笼罩。
轰！
随着曦光将两人笼罩，祭坛之中的创世之力和曦光之力全部涌入叶凌天体内。
两股力量通过叶凌天的身躯、神魂再度注入澹台凰体内。
“唔......”
澹台凰只觉得全身酥麻，双眸迷离，束缚身躯的枷锁被打破，一种渴望的情绪突然出现在心头，神魂顿时彻底失守。
就好似一只鱼儿突然遇见了大海，想要跃入大海、吞噬海水，已经来不及去想太多。
撕啦！
澹台凰身上的衣裙化作齑粉，她瞬间扑到叶凌天怀里，一口吻上叶凌天，贪婪地吞噬叶凌天身上的力量。
叶凌天神色一滞，立刻道：“统子......情况不对劲！”
系统并未回复，直接屏蔽叶凌天和澹台凰。
澹台凰不断吞噬叶凌天身上的力量，叶凌天也逐渐感觉神魂失守，内心变得无比渴望。
他们神魂本就融合在一起，澹台凰的那股强烈的渴望情绪，自然也影响到了叶凌天的神魂。
叶凌天的神魂彻底失守，他下意识伸出手，揽着澹台凰的腰肢，贪婪地索取......
——————
三天后。
祭坛内部的创世之力，全部消失，那抹曦光也不见了，祭坛之上，还放着创世图和澹台凰的大半块长生印。
澹台凰坐在祭坛上，换上了一件干净的红裙子，面容红润，倾城绝世，美艳无双，她拿出一个木梳，正在轻轻梳着发丝。

叶凌天则是闭目躺在祭坛上，身上弥漫着一股道尊之境的威压，整个人好似陷入了某种顿悟。
“......”
澹台凰看了叶凌天一眼，双眸之中，浮现一丝迷离，脸上还有一抹笑意。
她本就有两手打算，第一个盘算行不通，这第二个盘算，虽然与她预想之中的有很大区别，但结果却是一样的。
过了好一会儿。
叶凌天缓缓睁开眼睛，他轻轻揉了一下脑袋。
此刻他只觉得神魂消耗严重，全身腰酸背疼，消耗巨大。
“醒啦！”
澹台凰声音轻柔。
“大凰，我......”
叶凌天坐起身来，他看了一眼澹台凰，欲言又止。
虽然两人一直睡在一起，他也想占占便宜，但是这一次发生的事情，不在他的预料之中。
澹台凰轻然一笑：“没事，我允许的！”
说着，她身上弥漫出一股道尊九境巅峰的威压。
“道尊九境巅峰？”
叶凌天诧异地看着澹台凰。
之前那股创世主的力量和曦光之力，有九成都到了澹台凰身上，他只是得到其中一成。
那抹曦光，极为关键，也极为强大，比之创世主的力量还要不凡，这是澹台凰能一步登天的关键所在。
澹台凰一步从道祖之境踏入道尊九境巅峰，这可比原始道祖合道众生之城还要来得更为简单粗暴。
澹台凰笑着道：“这一次的收获，远超我的预料，原本在我的预想中，能入道尊一境即可，没想到竟然直接踏入了道尊九境巅峰！你也不错，如今也踏入了道尊之境。”
content_en:
Russian qing.
The rules of the universe surge, and the mysterious power covers the Immortality Seal, which emits a ray of light of life and death.
This ray of light passed through the endless starry sky and shone on the altar of the Shijie. Ye Lingtian and Tantai Huang were immediately enveloped in the light.
boom!
As the light enveloped the two of them, all the power of creation and light in the altar poured into Ye Lingtian's body.
The two forces were injected into Tantai Huang's body again through Ye Lingtian's body and soul.
"Well..."
Tantai Huang only felt numb all over her body, her eyes were blurred, and the shackles that bound her body were broken. A feeling of longing suddenly appeared in her heart, and her soul was completely lost.
It's like a fish suddenly encounters the sea and wants to jump into the sea and swallow the sea water. It's too late to think too much.
Tear it apart!
Tantaihuang's dress turned into powder, and she immediately threw herself into Ye Lingtian's arms, kissed Ye Lingtian, and greedily devoured the power in Ye Lingtian.
Ye Lingtian's expression froze, and he immediately said: "Tongzi... something is wrong!"
The system did not reply and directly blocked Ye Lingtian and Tantaihuang.
Tantai Phoenix kept devouring Ye Lingtian's power, and Ye Lingtian gradually felt that his soul was lost, and his heart became extremely longing.
Their souls were already fused together, and Tantai Huang's strong desire naturally affected Ye Lingtian's soul.
Ye Lingtian's soul was completely lost. He subconsciously stretched out his hand, wrapped his arms around Tantaihuang's waist, and greedily asked for...
——————
Three days later.
The power of creation inside the altar has all disappeared, and the ray of sunlight has also disappeared. On the altar, there are still the creation diagram and most of Tantai Phoenix's longevity seal.
Tantaihuang sat on the altar, put on a clean red dress, her face was rosy, and she was extremely beautiful. She took out a wooden comb and was gently combing her hair.
Ye Lingtian was lying on the altar with his eyes closed, his body filled with the pressure of the Taoist realm, and his whole person seemed to have fallen into some kind of epiphany.
"..."
Tantaihuang glanced at Ye Lingtian, with a hint of confusion in his eyes and a smile on his face.
She had two plans. The first plan didn't work. Although the second plan was very different from what she expected, the result was the same.
After a while.
Ye Lingtian slowly opened his eyes and gently rubbed his head.
At this moment, he only felt that his soul was seriously consumed, his whole body was sore and his back was aching, and he was experiencing huge consumption.
"Wake up!"
Tantaihuang's voice was soft.
"Dahuang, I..."
Ye Lingtian sat up. He glanced at Tantaihuang and hesitated to speak.
Although the two of them had been sleeping together and he wanted to take advantage, what happened this time was not what he expected.
Tantaihuang smiled lightly: "It's okay, I allow it!"
As she spoke, a coercion at the peak of the ninth realm of Dao Zun filled her body.
"The peak of Dao Zun's ninth realm?"
Ye Lingtian looked at Tantai Huang in surprise.
Ninety percent of the previous power of the Creator and the power of light went to Tantai Huang, but he only got 10% of it.
That ray of light is extremely crucial and extremely powerful. It is even more extraordinary than the power of the Creator. This is the key to Tantai Phoenix's ability to reach the sky in one step.
Tantaihuang stepped from the realm of Tao Ancestor to the peak of Tao Zun Ninth Realm in one step, which is simpler and more crude than the original Tao Ancestor and the City of All Living Beings.
Tantaihuang said with a smile: "The harvest this time is far beyond my expectation. Originally, I expected that I could enter the first realm of Dao Zun, but I didn't expect that I would directly step into the peak of the ninth realm of Dao Zun! You are not bad, and now you have also stepped into the realm of Dao Zun."
